messages.subject: [Phylobase-devl] phylobase out!
messages.body_plain:
Everyone,

phylobase appears to be propagating to the CRAN mirrors now (it's  
already available at: <http://cran.at.r-project.org/>).  It took a  
little longer than planed because R-forge only allows you to submit a  
package after it's built as a nightly.  Appears someone decided to  
write a package "phybase" and release it about a month ago...

I'm really impressed w/ all the changes we've made since our last  
version (0.4).  The svn log was over 2000 lines and the NEWS file is  
pretty hefty.  I did my best to translate from the commit messages to  
NEWS items, so hopefully I got everyones changes in there.

Who wants to write up an announcement for r-sig-phylo?

Peter

  Thanks for doing this Peter!

visible yet. In the process, I realized it might be a good idea to
create a new mailing list for users. I can't do it because I don't have
the admin status on R-forge.

  Cheers,
  -- Fran?ois
